scientific_rules: development tasks are explicitly contaminated and cannot later count as blind evidence
holdout selection occurs only after engine memory adapters budgets selectors seeds and gates are frozen
no selected holdout may be swapped or dropped after solver-relevant access
no threshold or success-rule change is permitted after blind results begin
no expert patch hint hidden solution or prior leaderboard trajectory may influence a candidate before candidate freeze
causal-transfer credit requires equal-budget full no-memory random-memory and exact learned-gene-removal evidence
semantic genes enter long-term causal memory only after prospective transfer evidence
global breakthrough requires heterogeneous external evidence independent reproduction and an external-frontier result
note: OMEGA0 locks the direction and integrity boundary. Exact OMEGA10 thresholds must be preregistered before any final holdout identity is selected.
